sources.title: Upgrading agentic coding capabilities with the new Devstral models
sources.evidence: July 10, 2025 announcement identifies devstral-medium-2507, collaboration with All Hands AI, API access and enterprise private-infrastructure deployment/customization. Public Apache-2.0 weights and 24B specifications apply to Small 1.1, not Medium.

sources.title: Devstral Medium 1.0
sources.evidence: Exact API ID, July 10 release, Premier classification, text model, advertised 128k context and Function Calling feature. Documents deprecation on February 27, 2026. No parameter count or internal architecture is displayed.

sources.title: Mistral documentation model catalog used by the model-selection guide
sources.evidence: Read the published client data without executing it. Exact Devstral Medium 1.0 object has releaseDate 2025-07-10, type Premier, weights [], paperlink null, contextLength 128k, input/output text, function-calling feature, and retirementDate 2026-05-31. No count, architecture or explicit reasoning boolean appears in its object.

sources.title: Devstral Medium 1 legal model record
sources.evidence: Identifies Medium 1.0 and July 10, 2025. Inspected the embedded Technical Documentation tab: it provides an explanation of documentation requirements, not model architecture or parameter counts. Its Active lifecycle label conflicts with the developer docs deprecation/retirement metadata.

sources.title: Official Mistral Hugging Face Devstral repositories
sources.evidence: Current official-organization search returns Small 2505/2507, Small 2 and Devstral 2 repositories, including GGUF versions; no exact public Medium 2507 checkpoint. This corroborates, but alone does not establish, the commercial distribution classification.

sources.title: Later Devstral 2 model card and size comparison table
sources.evidence: Inspected full later card, especially the explicitly labeled size comparison table. It discloses 123B for Devstral 2 and 24B for Small 2, but has no July 2025 Devstral Medium row or parameter/architecture disclosure for that earlier model.

sources.title: Later Mistral Medium 3.5 model card
sources.evidence: Inspected later merged-model card and comparisons. Its 128B dense specification is expressly for Medium 3.5, which replaces Devstral 2 in Vibe; it does not establish the size or architecture of Devstral Medium 2507.

sources.title: Mistral reasoning documentation
sources.evidence: Explains native thinking output and configurable reasoning for supported models. Does not make an explicit supported/unsupported statement for devstral-medium-2507. General agentic task performance is not proof of a dedicated native thinking mode.

sources.title: Models.dev Devstral Medium catalog record
sources.evidence: Baseline lead is accessible and asserts reasoning unsupported and 128000 context. Its technical assertions are not treated as primary verification; primary docs confirm nominal 128k but do not explicitly settle dedicated-thinking status.

sources.title: OpenRouter exact Devstral Medium 2507 endpoint record
sources.evidence: Returns the Devstral Medium identity, text+file to text route description and an empty endpoints array. Provider file preprocessing does not establish an additional native model modality; the response does not verify a current served endpoint or context boundary.

name.note: Use the developer documentation versioned name for the fixed 2507 release.

developer.note: Retain normalized developer Mistral; the launch credits collaboration with All Hands AI.

family.note: Developer identifies the release in the Devstral coding-model line.

release_date.note: Dated first-party launch and exact API identifier agree; not the later Devstral 2 release.

open_weights.note: Premier commercial model. Enterprise access to private deployment is distinct from public weights; the launch explicitly releases Small weights instead.

license.note: Descriptive commercial distribution classification, not an asserted contract title. No public redistributable Medium weights license is supplied; Small Apache-2.0 is not transferred.

parameters_b.note: No exact Medium 2507 total disclosed in reviewed launch, docs/catalog, legal technical tab or later Devstral 2/Medium 3.5 cards and comparison tables. Exact-name primary searches found no later count. Small 24B and successor 123B/128B are not evidence for this model.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact Medium 2507 active count is reported in the reviewed primary material. Neither a sibling active count nor an assumed dense total is substituted.

architecture.note: Reviewed exact developer sources and searched exact-name training, interpretability and technical-report references. No internal architecture disclosure found. Later Devstral 2 dense architecture and Small ancestry do not establish Medium 2507 architecture.

context_window.note: Developer advertises 128k; retain decimal nominal normalization to 128000. The inspected primary data does not specify an exact 128000-versus-131072 token boundary or prove current endpoint operation.

modalities.note: Exact developer client catalog explicitly enumerates text input/output. Document QnA and a provider file route do not establish native image, audio or file encoders.

reasoning.note: The baseline false is only catalog-supported. Developer materials describe agentic coding but do not explicitly confirm or deny dedicated native thinking for this fixed revision; feature-list omission is insufficient for false.

tool_call.note: Exact model documentation and capability object explicitly support Function Calling.

description.value: Text model for software-engineering agents, with function calling for codebase exploration and multi-file edits.
description.note: Concise capability description limited to the exact model documentation; no benchmark or architecture inference.

patch.name: Devstral Medium 1.0
patch.description: Text model for software-engineering agents, with function calling for codebase exploration and multi-file edits.

sources.label: Upgrading agentic coding capabilities with the new Devstral models
Mistral documentation model catalog used by the model-selection guide

patch.notes: Mistral developed this release in collaboration with All Hands AI. Public weights were not released; private enterprise deployment and customization were offered. Total parameters, active parameters and internal architecture remain undisclosed in reviewed primary sources. Context is the developer-advertised 128k, normalized to 128000; the exact token boundary is unverified. Dedicated native-thinking status is unverified. Developer docs mark this API revision deprecated, while the legal lifecycle page still labels it Active; current endpoint operation was not verified.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for exact Devstral Medium 2507. Use versioned Medium 1.0 name, add proprietary classification and primary provenance, retain nominal 128k text-only context and native function calling, and clear unsupported categorical reasoning false. Public weights differ from enterprise private deployment. Counts and architecture remain undisclosed after later primary-card/comparison and exact-name research checks; successor and Small specifications are not transferred.
